The text recounts the meritorious deeds of the elder Tālavaṇṭadāyaka, conventionally linked to the offering of a palm-leaf fan (*tālavaṇṭa*) to a past Buddha. SuttaCentral registers five translations of the poem across five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
